name: brigade
description: Team messaging between Claude Code sessions of different people and machines, through a pluggable adapter CLI (Supabase adapter bundled).

profile.title: Brigade profile
profile.description: Adapter profile name; each profile is bound to exactly one team.

config_dir.title: Brigade config directory (advanced)
config_dir.description: Where adapter profiles live; leave empty for the platform default (~/.config/brigade), and note that the plugin ignores BRIGADE_CONFIG_DIR from the environment on purpose.

adapter_command.title: Adapter command override (advanced)
adapter_command.description: Per-session override of the profile's default adapter, given as an absolute path to an adapter executable, a JSON array such as ["/abs/adapter", "--flag"], or a name registered in adapters.json — never a shell command, and empty means the adapter the profile was created with.

team_inbound.title: Incoming team messages
team_inbound.description: accept (the default) delivers every team message into this session immediately, in every permission mode, and refuse never delivers and never acknowledges, so senders see this session as refusing; hold (review before delivery) arrives in a later release.

share_workspace_label.title: Share a workspace label
share_workspace_label.description: Send the workspace label below with this session, never the working directory path.

workspace_label.title: Workspace label
workspace_label.description: The label shared when share_workspace_label is on.

poll_on_prompt.title: Poll for messages on each prompt
poll_on_prompt.description: Fallback for hosts without an inbox socket: fetch unread messages when a prompt is submitted, applying the same inbound policy as the watcher.
